Priya: Heads-up — noticed a cohort of new onboarded accounts with healthscore wildly fluctuating (0 -> 80 in an hour). looks like a playbook loop firing on partial email contacts. anyone seen this before?
Marco: Yup saw similar two weeks ago, was caused by a stale dedupe rule that re-tagged records during enrichment. can you paste an example account id?
Priya: acct_gh12k9 — in the logs the playbook applied `welcome-sequence` then a separate automation re-added contact_stage shortly after.
Tessa: that sounds like the inbound webhook retrying and creating a shadow contact. i put a quick query in sandbox: `select id, email, contact_source, updated_at from contacts where email like '%@example.com' order by updated_at desc limit 5;`
Jaya: we should probably run a suppression dry-run for the playbook that gates on email_verified. propose adding a predicate: `email_verified = true or source in ('manual-import')` — keeps auto imports from flip-flopping scores.
Priya: +1. can we do dry-run logging only for 24h then surface a small sample in the playbook dashboard? want to avoid a mass backfill if it's noisy.
CSOps-Bot: playbook:welcome-sequence executed on acct_gh12k9 at 1796504300 (trigger: inbound-webhook). suppression-dryrun flag set by @Jaya. Dry-run mode: true.
Marco: plan: (1) enable suppression-dryrun on staging (2) collect telemetry for 24h (3) run a scoped backfill sample of 500 accounts (4) review healthscore diffs. who owns the rollout?
Jaya: i can own the staging flip and sample backfill. will add a rollout ticket and a `manual-rollback` tag.
Tessa: i'll add a small eval set for healthscore regression checks, include 25 accounts that historically oscillate. can we also log the exact playbook decision path (prefix cache id + rule id)?
Priya: yes please — add `decision_path` and `rule_snapshot` to the dry-run logs. also add a quick alert if >5% of sample sees a >30pt jump.
Marco: adding the alert. will wire a temporary PagerDuty rule to the cs-ops rotation for the 48h window.
Jaya: putting the PR up: https://github.com/redwood-inference/cs-playbooks/pull/412 — contains predicate, instrumentation, and sample backfill job.
Priya: looks good. schedule: target staging flip in 2h, sample backfill at +6h, review at +30h. tagging owners in the ticket. :thumbsup:
CSOps-Bot: runbook-note: if suppression-dryrun reduces playbook hits by >40% on sample, promote to `soft-suppression` and schedule production rollout with opt-out window.
Marco: thanks everyone. once we see staging numbers i'll create the postmortem-lite doc if anything odd shows up.
Priya: appreciated. cc: @all — please keep message updates concise in the ticket so we can audit the decision trail.
